blocks.text: Scan scope allows you to select specific DLP engines that must be used to detect and classify sensitive data in specific file types. Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is used to scan and identify sensitive data in image files and also images embedded within files. AI Security uses only the specified DLP engines to scan the resources for sensitive data. AI Security
To create a new scan scope, complete the following steps in the AI Security Admin Portal:

blocks.item: Go to Administration > Scan Settings.
Select the Scan Scope tab.
On the Scan Scope page, click Create Scan Scope.
On the General Information page:
Engine Scope Name: Enter a descriptive name for your scan scope.
Engine Scope Description: Provide a detailed explanation of what the scan scope covers.
See image.
Click Next.
On the Select Criteria page:
DLP Engine: Choose DLP engines for the scan scope. Choose all for a comprehensive scan or specific DLP engines to focus on specific DLP engines.

Specific DLP Engines: Choose the DLP engines that must be included in the scan scope. This option is enabled only if you select specific DLP engines to scan. To learn more, see About Data Classification Settings.
A DLP engine must be enabled so you can select it while configuring the scan scope. A DLP engine that is not enabled appears grayed out and cannot be selected.

If you disable a DLP engine that is currently selected in a scan scope, it is displayed as grayed out with a partial selection indicator. The scanner does not evaluate this DLP engine, even if it is still partially selected.
When a DLP engine is deleted, it is automatically removed from all existing scan scopes.
File Type: Choose the file types that must be included in the scan scope.
AI Security uses OCR to scan and identify sensitive data in image files (e.g., .png, .jpeg, .tiff, .bmp, .gif) and also images that are embedded within documents (e.g., .pdf, .docx, .pptx).
Machine Learning Document Scan: Enable if you want to use machine learning-powered document scanning.
File type filters and machine learning document scans are optimized for cloud storage and VM resources.
See image.
Click Next.
On the Summary page, review the configured details. Click the Edit icon to modify the scan scope, if required. To learn more, see Editing or Deleting Scan Scopes.
See image.
Click Finish.

blocks.text: You can apply the scan scope while configuring the scan settings.
